text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly labeled as a "REVIEW" in the title and structure, synthesizing existing knowledge on land-use change (LUC) related to bioenergy policies. It discusses land-use modeling tools, indirect land-use change (iLUC), data sources, and policy implications, with significant focus on how land-use models represent future LULC dynamics under bioenergy scenarios. Although it does not present original modeling or national-scale projections, it critically evaluates land-use models (e.g., IMAGE, MiniCAM, EPPA) used for forecasting LULC under future bioenergy expansion, addressing uncertainties, data gaps, and scenario design—thus meeting the criterion of a review that touches on LULC future prediction.)
